metrics.evaluation_definition: Exact entity-level evaluation (matching: (start, end, label)). Precision = TP/(TP+FP), Recall = TP/(TP+FN), F1 = 2PR/(P+R).

intent_classification.statistical_limitation: DATASET LIMITATION: Total benchmark contains 183 examples across 11 classes (~16 samples/class). The held-out test set contains 28 samples (~2 per class). Class distributions have variance; 5-fold cross-validation is reported to provide confidence intervals.
